scope: Additional local API comparisons with frozen weights, prompts, thresholds and evaluation identities; no training or quality-driven tuning
execution_order: Generate an immutable executable plan only after the primary three-variant campaign is completed

prefix_off_quality_reference.configuration: Copy each matching primary variant's server configuration and change only prefix_cache from on to off
prefix_off_quality_reference.comparison: Pair by unique review identity against the matching prefix-on primary quality run; report label-set changes, all changed aspect/sentiment assignments, presence/pair F1 and latency. Do not assert equivalence from the 100-development-review gate alone.
prefix_off_quality_reference.timing_limit: Sequential on/off runs can differ in thermal and clock conditions; record telemetry and do not call the observed ratio an isolated causal estimate
prefix_off_quality_reference.selection_rule: Do not use the 957-review comparison to retune thresholds, prompts, weights or the primary operating point

common_absolute_arrival_rate.reference_requirements: Completed primary campaign, each reference noninterrupted with at least 99% success and positive finite complete-review throughput
common_absolute_arrival_rate.rate_rule: 0.5 times the minimum across variants of their three C1-reference throughput medians
common_absolute_arrival_rate.rate_units: Complete review requests per second, identical absolute value for all variants
common_absolute_arrival_rate.configuration: Copy matching primary server configuration without other changes
common_absolute_arrival_rate.interpretation: Compare latency and successful delivery under the same absolute arrival schedule; this conservative rate is not a maximum-capacity estimate

provenance: Executable plan records this registration hash, primary plan hash, capacity reference summary hashes, frozen artifact hash and replay hashes before any extension service starts
outputs: Private raw evidence stays in ignored outputs; publish only aggregate performance, quality and paired label-change statistics with coverage
